Comenius Early Career Psychologist Award
opportunities.summary: Honour of the European Federation of Psychologists' Associations: the Comenius award is designed to recognise a psychologist whose academic and teaching career in psychology is developing, particularly for the quality of their academic contribution to excellent teaching and learning. It was given to EFPA in 2007 by the Union of Psychologists' Associations of the Czech Republic and is awarded during the European Congress of Psychology.

opportunities.title: Vienna Research Groups
opportunities.summary: Major funding for international top young researchers to establish a research group in Vienna. 6–8 year duration. Application in tandem with an established scientist at a Viennese research institution.

opportunities.title: Post-DocTrack Fellowship
opportunities.summary: Bridges the phase between PhD completion and a postdoc position in the humanities, social and cultural sciences: finish dissertation publications, develop an own research project for funding applications, build networks. 3–12 months, plus travel allowance up to €2,000.

opportunities.title: MSCA Doctoral Networks
opportunities.summary: Doctoral programmes implemented by partnerships of universities, research institutions and infrastructures, businesses including SMEs and other socio-economic actors from different countries across Europe and beyond, to train highly skilled doctoral candidates and expose them to both the academic and the non-academic sectors. Besides standard Doctoral Networks there are Industrial Doctorates, jointly supervised by academic and non-academic partners, and Joint Doctorates leading to a joint or multiple doctoral degrees. Applicants are consortia of at least three independent legal entities, each established in a different EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country and at least one of them in an EU Member State; organisations from any country in the world can join on top of that minimum. opportunities.title: KLI Visiting Fellowships
opportunities.summary: Research stays at the KLI in Klosterneuburg for theoretical and interdisciplinary projects: Early Career (late-stage doctorate or up to 8 years after the PhD, 1 week to 6 months) and Senior (more than 8 years after the PhD, 1 week to 3 months). No stipend – the KLI covers travel and accommodation for limited periods; own funding required.

opportunities.title: KLI Resident Fellowships
opportunities.summary: Fellowships at the KLI in Klosterneuburg for theoretical, reflexive, and interdisciplinary projects on life and cognition in its biological, cognitive, social, and cultural diversity. Three tracks: Writing-Up (late-stage doctorate, up to 6 months, €2,550/month gross), Postdoctoral (up to 8 years after the doctorate, up to 3 years, €3,850/month), and Senior (8–15 years after the doctorate, up to 3 years, €4,200/month), each with travel and library allowance.

opportunities.title: International Communication
opportunities.summary: ÖFG travel-funding programme, open to all disciplines including psychology. It supports: presenting new research findings at international conferences abroad, small international symposia/workshops in Austria, short-term research stays at institutions abroad (max. 3 months), and inviting foreign researchers. The travel lines are aimed primarily at early-career researchers up to age 40 (3 years credited per child for care time, up to 3 years for illness/disability); at least one peer-reviewed international publication is required. Congress fees, travel and hotel costs are covered; only one substantial grant per person and year.

opportunities.title: Erwin Schrödinger Fellowship
opportunities.summary: International research stay (10–24 months) for highly qualified young researchers at leading foreign institutions. With optional return phase (up to 12 months).

opportunities.title: ESPRIT Programme
opportunities.summary: Career development program for postdocs. Supports independent research under mentoring by an experienced scientist.

opportunities.title: ERC Consolidator Grants
opportunities.summary: For more experienced researchers who want to consolidate their group and research line. Open to all topics, highly competitive. 5-year duration.

opportunities.title: Dr. Maria Schaumayer Foundation Prizes and Recognitions
opportunities.summary: Prizes awarded twice a year for completed scientific works by women: master's or diploma thesis, doctoral dissertation, or habilitation (no bachelor's theses). The work must be no older than three semesters, graded "excellent" by all reviewers, and not previously awarded elsewhere. Austrian citizenship is required; in exceptional cases, EU citizens with their main residence in Austria and particularly close ties to the country may apply. Open to all disciplines — the 2025 award winners include a psychology master's thesis on mindfulness and relaxation exercises. Submission is online with the thesis, a German abstract, CV, transcript, and reviewer reports.

opportunities.title: DGPs Travel Grants (Educational Psychology Division)
opportunities.summary: Grants from the German Psychological Society for conference participation by early-career researchers in educational psychology. The DGPs is the learned society of the German-speaking area; no country restriction stated. Other divisions offer similar early-career support.

opportunities.title: AK Science Prize (AK Upper Austria)
opportunities.summary: Annual prize of the Upper Austrian Chamber of Labour for scientific works that serve to improve employees' working and living conditions. Two categories: dissertations and scientific articles (total prize money €9,000, split among up to 3 winners; open topic aligned with the Chamber's fields of interest) and master's/diploma theses (stipend up to €1,000 plus publication in WISO; fixed topic per cycle, currently "Energie der Zukunft"). Applications from habilitated professors are excluded.
